Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in its "Updated Understanding" during Step 3. It incorrectly stated that VMF-213 was assigned to the USS Ranger (CV-4), whereas the search results from Step 2 (specifically the Wikipedia snippet and the airgroup4.com page) clearly indicated the assignment was to the USS Essex (CV-9). This hallucination of the carrier name led to an incorrect final answer. The error likely stemmed from a confusion between the USS Essex and the USS Ranger, or a misreading of the search results where the Planner substituted the correct carrier name with an incorrect one despite the evidence pointing to the Essex.
